people.name: Artaxerxes
people.line: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time

people.name: Azariah
people.line: Grandfather of Ezra, descended from High Priests

people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

people.name: Hilkiah
people.line: The high priest who discovered the Book of the Law.

people.name: Persia

people.name: Seraiah
